The main text mentions 王丞相 (Wang Dao as Chancellor), and the Liu annotation (sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-liu-annotation-004) explicitly states 爲王導所辟, confirming 王導 as the person who recruited 王濛 and 王述. The canonical name match is direct and the annotation provides explicit identification. No contradicting evidence exists.

The main text (sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-main) mentions 桓宣武 in the context of 桓公語人曰, and the surrounding narrative about 殷王清言 fits the historical context of 桓溫. Accepting on the strength of the alias registry match and historical uniqueness.

The mention 王長史 is resolved to 王濛. The Liu annotation sfh1-ev-04-wenxue-022-liu-annotation-004 states '王濛王述並爲王導所辟', confirming 王濛 as one of the two Wangs recruited by 王導.
